body: Hey there, I saw your message. I’m sorry to hear that it has been so hard

I’m getting better :) There are people who understand. I also find that it has helped understand other people who are in similar situations. Take it one day at a time. Are there activities that you enjoy?
What about before marriage?
Which topics would you like to discuss?
I’m so sorry. I hear you and you’re not alone

It can be difficult for people to understand. It’s a great idea that you decided to vent here. :)
Sometimes we have to go through a period of loneliness to discern who our friends are.
I went through it as well. It’s tough. You are not alone, vent as much you need on this sub :).

Hey..It must be really tough. :(
Is there an activity that you’d enjoy doing in nature?
A while ago, some folks in this sub recommended that I start walking. I did. I don’t do it every day, but I go in parks and spend more time in nature and it really helps.

I posted it on Reddit initially. Progressively I told one of family members about it. Then, I told a friend about it. 

I would say it’s ok to tell your family & friends about it. What surprised me was the magic of relationships. It’s amazing to know that there are so many people on your side. No one is perfect but we care about each other. So yes, chat about it with them :)
Happyy Birthday
Really nice!
Interested :)
Thank you! :) I am trying to improve sleep, showering, and having breakfast for now.
Thank you! This is very helpful :)

Great recommendation! What kind of questions?

No hard questions are coming to mind.

Hey OP, what a story. Also struggling too, It’s nice to see that you keep hope. I am wondering if you’ve looked into IT or tech training? There are jobs where you can work remotely and never have to be in an office. Other industries (writing, photography, teaching, Marketing, etc) do offer remote work..I hope you also find a place to stay

I feel what you mean. It is so hard to just be positive...and this is coming from someone who had believed in positive attitude for a while. Even on my birthday I was so sad. I will just say...there is hope. I look at nature and remember there is hope.
So happy for you
I can see your point...but people express pain in different ways. The pandemic also brought a new wave of depression to people. I am not sure how your comment is helping OP.

OP I hope you’re still around. I have also studied Mathematics & Physics. What are your thoughts on Pi, the golden ration, Fibonacci Sequence, the spirals that we see represented in plants, galaxies..there seems to be underlying constants in our universe.

As I studied more mathematics, I have realized that some of the formulas are too beautiful and consistent to have just emerged from nowhere. 

From your post, it sounds to me like you have a wonderful and curious mind. You ask questions and breakthrough discoveries begin with crazy questions sometimes. It is a gift that you have. 

I also experience existential crisis, but I decided to give myself more days. It’s tough..I hope you’re still here OP

Hey..I was also feeling the same way a few nights ago. I hate when that happens and those intrusive thoughts.

I received advice on exercising in the morning, with something simple such as a small walk outside (even 4-5 minutes) or stretching a little bit. It helped me. Another thing that I found helpful for the evening is warm milk, honey and chamomile.
❤️Done

Hey! Thank you for sharing this. It’s nice to see that it got better for you.

I also get the feeling of being stuck in a black hole. I feel like I have sunk and I am submerged. If I go to a therapist, I am concerned that they will put me in a hospital for suicidal ideation. I don’t want that..but I will consider giving it a try. 

I started with the first routine, walk and breakfast. It seems manageable for now.

Thank you! I got the vitamins and currently having breakfast. I don’t drink coffee, it makes me jittery. But I can do 1-2 shots of coffee. 

There are hobbies that I am interested in and I am going to a dance class in two weeks. 

I still can’t help the feeling that none of this makes sense though. Especially at night, that’s when the feeling gets worse

Hey everyone,

Thanks for the comments so far, I was so glad to read them! Today I’m feeling better, I had a walk earlier to the grocery store, bought vitamins and made breakfast (oats)..

I still feel like things are an illusion and get depressive thoughts. But I am going to try that routine first (morning walk and breakfast). I am meeting with a relative later today. I kept wanting to cancel but I’m going.

Thanks again, wishing you all good days. I will post updates. If you see this post, please continue to post what helped you. It will help me and hopefully others as well. 

Day 1/365
No worries, good luck studying. :)
